notice: This explorer shows curated pathways of plant perception — how plants detect light, gravity, touch, temperature, water, nutrients, microbes, herbivores and chemical cues — with the molecules involved and the evidence for each step. It is a research and teaching tool, not a reference work. "Verified" means a reference was checked at abstract level, not full text. "Perception" means signal detection by receptors; the app takes no position on plant consciousness.
caution: Counts of paths per molecule are NOT centrality. Well-studied receptors (phyB, FERONIA) accrue rows by study volume. Any hub claim needs a study-intensity-controlled comparison. Matching is on the receptor stage only.
